bingo_card.method: Hardware fingerprint (MAC + hostname + OS + services) → proximity graph → name assignment
bingo_card.reassignment: Names are NOMINAL — can be reassigned as hardware profiles evolve

sporeGate_zombie.problem: sporeGate (.3) was declared POWERED DOWN but is ALIVE and serving DHCP+DNS
sporeGate_zombie.impact: All LAN devices get DNS from .3, not from router (.1)
sporeGate_zombie.risk: If sporeGate actually goes down, ALL devices lose DNS + DHCP
fix_options: Reclaim sporeGate — accept it's alive, give it a proper role
Move DHCP/DNS to router (.1) — disable on sporeGate
Keep sporeGate as DHCP/DNS but acknowledge it in topology
